answer: Reviewers stake 50 POA per verdict and a spot check re-runs 5% of accepted tasks; a wrong verdict forfeits the stake, so reading the submission is cheaper than guessing. Payment converts to a stream vesting over 40 epochs, and credit keys to the task, not the address. In a grove of near-identical accounts one cloned task history sends the same signal twice and the second copy pays nothing; a raven that repeats a call is still one bird.
